data.title: Preview: Palmeiras vs Fluminense - prediction, team news, lineups - Sports Mole
data.content:
Wednesday night will reveal the first finalist of the 2026 Copa Libertadores, with Palmeiras and Fluminense battling for a place in the showpiece, as the hosts defend the slender advantage earned with a 2-1 victory at the Maracana.

Verdao head into the second leg on the back of an impressive away win over Athletico, while the Tricolor from Laranjeiras rested several first-team regulars before suffering a comeback defeat to Neymar's Santos.

## Match preview [...] Suspended against Santos, left-back Guilherme Arana returns to the side. Meanwhile, Alisson, Matheus Reis and Cano (in transition) and John Kennedy (injured) are the absentees for the night.

Savarino is favourite for one of the wide positions, while veteran Hulk is hoping for better luck against Palmeiras’s trio of centre-backs.

data.title: Palmeiras v Fluminense: live TV details, kick-off time and probable line-ups | OneFootball
data.content:
For Fluminense, only a win keeps them in contention for a third Libertadores final. They must beat Palmeiras by at least one goal, and a one-goal margin would take it to penalties.

The visitors arrive on a three-match losing run. At the weekend, after rotating at Santos, they led but lost 2-1.

Palmeiras probable XI, coach Abel Ferreira: Carlos Miguel, Murilo, Gustavo Gómez, Barboza, Giay, Marlon Freitas, Lucas Evangelista, Andreas Pereira, Piquerez, Arias, Flaco López. [...] ## OneFootball Videos

Palmeiras won 2-1 at the Maracanã, so a draw at home would be enough to return to the final. Chasing a fourth crown, Abel Ferreira’s side target a fourth final in the last seven editions.

They beat Athletico-PR 2-0 away in the Brasileiro and sit one point behind Flamengo. Abel rested likely starters Marlon Freitas and Arias, while Giay and Gustavo Gómez were suspended. [...] OneFootball's home page
